name: @sos-2/memory
description: SOS 2.0 Architecture Memory: versioned ArchitectureMemory artifacts holding predictions, observations, outcomes, FAILURES (contexts retained, never dropped), TECHNICAL LIABILITIES (first-class records with severity, owner-kind and a validated resolution state machine — deletions rejected, only resolution may change), rollback events and learned rules (applicability context + supporting evidence refs, rules without evidence rejected); every memory update is a versioned supersedes chain entry that preserves provenance (who/what produced it, from which evidence) and the append-only evolution rule is machine-enforced; complete, contiguous, queryable history (Work Order W5; requirements R19, R21, R22, R30).
